skill.name: invoice-ocr-sorter
skill.description: Organize invoice and bill screenshots or PDFs with OCR guidance, classification steps, and Excel-ready output.
skill.summary: Turns invoice and bill files into categorized, Excel-ready summaries.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a high-entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Manual review shows a plain Markdown skill description for invoice and bill OCR sorting. No prompt injection, scripts, external commands, network activity, or data exfiltration intent were found.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.18 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable Markdown with front matter, Chinese text, and normal usage notes. No binary, encrypted, or obfuscated payload is present in the reviewed file.

content.value_statement: Invoice images and PDFs are hard to compare when details stay trapped in files. This skill guides OCR extraction, category sorting, and Excel-ready summaries.
actual_capabilities: Guides extraction of invoice and bill details from screenshots or PDFs.
Defines common fields such as vendor, date, invoice number, tax, and total.
Supports categorizing documents by expense type or supplier.
Prepares information for Excel-style rows and review workflows.
Reminds users to manually review important financial outputs.
limitations: The repository contains instructions only, not a bundled OCR engine.
Accuracy depends on the quality of the uploaded image or PDF.
Human review is required before bookkeeping, tax, or payment decisions.
It does not connect directly to accounting systems or bank feeds.

use_cases.title: Prepare Monthly Expense Reports
use_cases.description: Convert receipt screenshots and invoice PDFs into a consistent list for expense review.

use_cases.title: Sort Supplier Invoices
use_cases.description: Group supplier bills by category, due date, and total before entering them into finance tools.

use_cases.title: Create Shared Finance Summaries
use_cases.description: Standardize invoice fields so team members can review exceptions and update Excel files.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Invoice
prompt_templates.prompt: Use invoice-ocr-sorter on this invoice image. Extract vendor, date, invoice number, total, tax, and currency. Mark unreadable fields for review.

prompt_templates.title: Sort A Small Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these bill screenshots and PDFs. Classify each item by vendor type and expense category, then prepare an Excel-ready table.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Process this month of invoices. Group by supplier, category, currency, and payment status. Flag duplicate invoice numbers and missing totals.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Review Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable invoice sorting workflow for a finance team. Define required fields, review rules, exception labels, and final Excel columns.

output_examples.input: Three restaurant receipt screenshots and one utility bill PDF.
output_examples.output: A table-ready summary with vendor names, dates, totals, tax amounts, meal and utilities categories, and two unreadable tax fields flagged.

output_examples.input: A monthly folder of supplier invoices.
output_examples.output: Invoices grouped by supplier and due date, with duplicate invoice numbers noted and totals prepared for Excel import.

best_practices: Upload clear files with visible dates, totals, and supplier names.
Define the required Excel columns before processing a large batch.
Review flagged or low-confidence fields before using the results.
anti_patterns: Do not treat OCR results as final financial records without review.
Do not mix unrelated months or entities in one batch without labels.
Do not upload sensitive invoices unless the active AI tool is approved for that data.

faq.question: Does this skill include OCR software?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow instructions for using AI-assisted OCR and sorting inside supported tools.

faq.question: Can it process both screenshots and PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description covers invoice or bill screenshots and PDF uploads.

faq.question: Can it create Excel-ready results?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the assistant to organize extracted fields into rows suitable for Excel.

faq.question: Should I verify the extracted totals?
faq.answer: Yes. Financial outputs should be checked against the original invoice or bill.

faq.question: Can it classify expenses?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide category assignment by supplier, document type, or expense purpose.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
